identityScope: Four existing catalog rows that previously had no field review were reviewed against current Narwal US product pages. Freo X10 Pro, Freo X Plus, Freo Z10 Turbo and Flow are four separate models with their own product pages. No new model was created and no Narwal company focus review exists. The pages publish current prices, robot dimensions and weights for all four, battery capacities for the X10 Pro, Z10 Turbo and Flow, and dock dimensions for the X10 Pro and Flow. The X10 Pro, X10 Plus and Z10 Turbo pages publish no run time in minutes, so the catalog X10 Pro, X10 Plus and Z10 Turbo run time values are cleared; the Flow page publishes no run time either and the catalog value is empty. No reviewed page publishes charging time, an IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate, water tank capacity or minimum aisle width. The Freo X Plus page marks the product as out of stock.

fields.description: The Narwal Freo X10 Pro is a robot vacuum and mop with 11,000 Pa suction, a dynamic detangling side brush, a zero-tangling conical floating roller brush and Dual Scrubbing Mops with Edge-to-Edge Extension. It measures 355 x 350 x 107.7 mm, weighs 3,700 +/-100 g and carries a 5,000 mAh battery. The all-in-one base station measures 431 x 403.5 x 461.5 mm, weighs 8,400 +/-100 g and draws 45 W; it washes and dries the mops and holds a disposable dust bag for up to 120 days. The robot is 4.24 in (107.7 mm) tall, connects over 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only, emits 72 W maximum output power and is covered by a 1-year warranty. The page publishes no run time in minutes, charging time, IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate, water tank capacity or minimum aisle width; the catalog 219 min run time is cleared.

highlights: The Narwal Freo X10 Pro delivers 11,000 Pa suction with a zero-tangling conical floating roller brush.
Dual Scrubbing Mops extend edge to edge to reach corners, edges and toe kicks.
It measures 355 x 350 x 107.7 mm, weighs 3,700 +/-100 g and carries a 5,000 mAh battery.
The all-in-one dock washes and dries the mops and holds a disposable dust bag for up to 120 days.
It is 4.24 in tall, uses 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only and carries a 1-year warranty; no run time is published.

fields.description: The Narwal Freo X Plus is a robot vacuum and mop that removes over 99% of particles from hard floors and is claimed to keep a 0% tangle rate with pet fur and hair. Its base station compresses dust for up to seven weeks of hands-free storage, uses a HEPA disposable dust bag with auto drying and measures 27.5 x 11.8 x 13.7 cm at 860 +/-100 g. A tri-laser array with side, front and top sensors handles obstacle avoidance, and LiDAR 360-degree scanning plans the cleaning route. The robot measures 35.0 x 35.5 x 10.7 cm and weighs 4,250 +/-100 g. Siri voice control and a furniture cleaning mode in the Narwal app are included, and the page marks the product as out of stock. The page publishes no battery capacity, run time in minutes, charging time, IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate, water tank capacity or minimum aisle width; the catalog 254 min run time is cleared.

fields.description: The Narwal Freo Z10 Turbo is a robot vacuum and mop with 25,000 Pa suction, a DualFlow tangle-free system, a dual Reuleaux triangle mop with 12 N downward pressure and EdgeReach mop extension. It measures 13.98 x 13.78 x 4.24 in, weighs 4.5 kg (9.92 lb) and carries a 5,200 mAh battery. The adaptive dock measures 16.97 x 15.88 x 18.17 in, weighs 10.6 kg, washes the mops with water up to 161.6 F (72 C) and dries them with hot air. LDS navigation and detection for more than 100 objects guide the robot, which lifts its mops 12 mm on carpets and climbs thresholds up to 0.78 in (2 cm). The robot is covered by a 1-year warranty. The page publishes no run time in minutes, charging time, IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate, water tank capacity or minimum aisle width.

A dual Reuleaux triangle mop applies 12 N of downward pressure with EdgeReach extension.
It measures 13.98 x 13.78 x 4.24 in, weighs 4.5 kg and carries a 5,200 mAh battery.
The adaptive dock washes mops at up to 161.6 F, dries them and holds the dust.
LDS navigation detects more than 100 objects and lifts the mops 12 mm on carpets.

fields.description: The Narwal Flow is a robot vacuum and mop with 22,000 Pa suction, a FlowWash rolling track mop that sprays 113 F (45 C) water through 16 nozzles at 110 scrubs per minute and 12 N of pressure, and a scraper that collects dirty water in a separate tank. Dual RGB AI cameras and an onboard AI chip handle obstacle avoidance, and the robot is 95 mm tall, climbs thresholds up to 40 mm and carries a 6,400 mAh battery at 14.4 V. The basic dock measures 431 x 426.8 x 461.5 mm, weighs 11.3 kg, runs on 120 V 60 Hz input and 20 V-2.0 A output, charges at 45 W and holds a 2.5 L dust bag for up to 120 days. The page publishes no run time in minutes, charging time, IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate, water tank capacity or minimum aisle width.
